parsed_output.email_body:
Dear MERIT Beauty Team,

I hope this email finds you well. As a brand outreach consultant, I've been closely following MERIT Beauty's impressive journey in the clean beauty market. Your commitment to quality and timeless appeal has resonated deeply with your target audience, and I believe there's an opportunity to further engage younger demographics through a collaborative Instagram post.

We propose a behind-the-scenes look at the creation of a new product line. This series of posts would showcase the process from concept to final product, highlighting the quality and timeless appeal of your products. This approach would not only demonstrate your commitment to quality but also resonate with younger audiences who value innovation and timeless appeal.

We believe this initiative could help MERIT Beauty reach a wider audience and strengthen your position as a leader in the clean beauty market.

Looking forward to discussing this further.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
